text: The fixed setter calls GetDBFolderInfoAndDB, changes the cached member and folder-info field only when that call succeeds, then returns NS_OK even if it failed. It also does not propagate SetUserSortOrder or Commit results. The getter ignores ReadDBFolderInfo result before returning the member. These exact static boundaries limit what a caller can infer from a successful API return; they do not establish an observed data-loss failure. The inspected Panorama FolderInfo user-order methods remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED, so this patch is not proof of complete new-database support. Targeted failure and persistence tests remain source-ingestion gaps.
title: A successful SetUserSortOrder return does not prove the database write succeeded
